tasks.title: Fold VehicleKinematics.Profiles into MatchSim.DataHash
tasks.why: UnitDefinitions.Apply writes three tables (world.Units, CombatCatalogueSystem, VehicleKinematicsSystem.Profiles) but MatchSim.cs:154 DataHash only folds Catalogue.Fingerprint and World.Units.Fingerprint, leaving Profiles out. VehicleKinematics.cs:759 hashes Profiles per tick, so a replay or peer built with different VehicleProfile numbers passes VerifyReplay's map/data/init checks and then desyncs on the first tick a vehicle moves, instead of being refused as NewReplayRecorder's own doc comment promises.
tasks.done_when: a test builds two matches, changes one Profiles entry in the second, and asserts VerifyReplay refuses rather than desyncs

tasks.title: Record ambient bombardment rate in the replay header
tasks.why: AmbientBombardmentSystem.ShellsPerMinute is set once by MatchSim.CreateBattlefield from BattlefieldParams.Bombardment, but it is not in Hash() (only nextTick and Fired are) and not in the replay header. ReplayRecorder.MapParams (Replay.cs:172, written at :204, read at :274) has no writer and no reader anywhere in Assets/_Project, so a battlefield replay is not self-contained: a rebuild with the wrong rate desyncs about tick 160 (the first shell is TickRate * 8).
tasks.done_when: a test records a battlefield match, reads BattlefieldParams.Deserialize(p.MapParams) back out of the replay and asserts Bombardment matches

tasks.title: Stop off-map payloads from delivering after the match ends
tasks.why: OffMapAbilitySystem.Step refuses a new SupportFire when w.WinnerTeam >= 0, but Deliver(w) at the end of Step (OffMapAbilities.cs:218) has no such guard, and SimWorld.Step never guards it either. Shells, gas, smoke and beams already scheduled keep landing after MatchEnded, and a ParaDrop in flight still calls w.Spawn, putting fresh men on the field of a finished match, unlike SectorControlSystem.Step and AmbientBombardmentSystem.Step which both return on WinnerTeam >= 0.
tasks.done_when: a test ends a match with a ParaDrop mid-warmup and asserts no DropLanded event after MatchEnded and Scheduled drains without spawning

tasks.title: Fix SeaLanding's StoresFirst constant, dead since StoresEvery is larger
tasks.why: SeaLanding.cs:201 gates the stores run on w.Tick >= StoresFirst (800, 'ticks before the first stores run (40 s)') && w.Tick % StoresEvery == 0 (1100). Since StoresEvery > StoresFirst, the first tick satisfying both is 1100, so StoresFirst is dead and the beach is empty for 55 s, not the 40 s the constant names. One player reinforcing by sea (any craft non-Idle at that instant) pushes the first boat out by another 55 s.
tasks.done_when: a test asserts a CraftInbound event at or before StoresFirst + 1 tick on a landing map with no deploys

tasks.title: A neutral objective locks every objective behind it for both teams
tasks.why: SectorControlSystem.Step skips any objective with s.Owner > 1 (SectorControl.cs:89, 'neutral objectives are a mission feature'), so a neutral objective (OwnerTeam 255) can never be captured; and Unlocked (SectorControl.cs:55-66) returns false for a team that does not already own every blocking objective, so states[k].Owner (255) never equals team and the whole side behind it, including the HQ, is permanently locked for BOTH teams. Latent today: no shipped map or generator makes a neutral objective.
tasks.done_when: a test on the pure SectorControlSystem.Unlocked with a neutral objective asserts the objective behind it is still unlocked for the attacker
